subject.title: feat(workboard): review gate hard blocks + workboard_submit_review tool

question: Should Workboard adopt a durable `ready_to_merge` status and fail-closed completion gate as the review lifecycle contract?
rationale: The code blockers are mechanical, but the durable status and fail-closed completion behavior affect existing Workboard users and need maintainer acceptance before merge.

options.title: Repair and keep the lifecycle
options.body: Accept the lifecycle direction only after the PR preserves existing envelopes, updates declarations and UI consumers, adds tests, and provides upgrade/real-run proof.

options.title: Redesign around existing statuses
options.body: Avoid the new durable status and implement the gate using the existing `review`/`done` lifecycle if maintainers do not want a stored `ready_to_merge` state.

options.title: Pause product direction
options.body: Keep the PR open only for discussion until a Workboard owner defines the review-gate contract separately.

recommendation.title: Repair and keep the lifecycle
recommendation.body: Accept the lifecycle direction only after the PR preserves existing envelopes, updates declarations and UI consumers, adds tests, and provides upgrade/real-run proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the Workboard coordination tool surface this PR extends and is the strongest feature-history owner signal.
